thought.text: "No service with identifier 'wms' available" — deegree loaded but didn't register the WMS service. Let me check the service init logs for errors:

reasoning_content:
"No service with identifier 'wms' available." — deegree has loaded the workspace, but can't find the "wms" service. deegree's service identifier: in the case of a deegree web service, the service ID is derived from the service file name. The files are wms.xml, bpwms.xml, etc. But the "No service with identifier 'wms' available" error suggests the service isn't registered.

Hmm, wait — in deegree 3.x, the service identifier within a workspace is... let me check the deegree workspace documentation. Actually, the URL path in the guide is `/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities` — this matches what I'm testing.

Possible causes: the workspace is loaded but service registration is failing (e.g., due to a JDBC/DB connection issue, the feature store failed to initialize and the service was disabled). Earlier in the log I saw "Building resource FeatureStoreProvider:xplansynarchive" and "Unhandled particle: MODEL_GROUP" warnings.

Let me check the deegree web service logs for errors in the xplan-services-wms context. Also, the app might need the DB to be reachable — it is reachable (localhost). Let me check the logs for service initialization errors.

Actually, another thought: the deegree web service needs a workspace, and which workspace to use is defined by the servlet's init-param or webapp.properties. For the deegree web service, the workspace is usually obtained from the servlet's init-param "workspaceName". The webapp.properties file in DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT maps web app context → workspace. That's already configured. Let me check the init-params for the "services" servlet in the WMS web.xml — the excerpt above showed a getAttachment servlet with a workspaceName init-param of xplan-services-wms-workspace. The "services" servlet (OGCFrontController) — does it have an init-param? In the excerpt, `<servlet><servlet-name>services</servlet-name><servlet-class>...OGCFrontController</servlet-class><load-on-startup>2</load-on-startup></servlet>` — no init-params are shown. So it's using webapp.properties.

Let me look at the full log of the WMS webapp during startup — there may have been service registration errors (e.g., theme initialization failed, feature store failed → service unavailable).

Let me try grepping the catalina.out of dienste for "wms" errors.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "grep -iE \"ERROR|Exception|failed\" /opt/tomcat-dienste/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -vE \"quartz|SimpleThreadPool|clearReferences\" | tail -25", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Find errors in dienste Tomcat log"}

summary: Find errors in dienste Tomcat log
